items.title: Section: The Six Things to Investigate

items.zh: 云何六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那？謂尋思時，尋思六事。一、義，二、事，三、相，四、品，五、時，六、理。既尋思已，復審伺察。
items.en: What is insight with objects differentiated by six things? That is, when investigating, one investigates six things: first, meaning; second, substance; third, characteristic; fourth, category; fifth, time; sixth, principle. Having investigated these, one further carefully examines them.

items.zh: 云何名為尋思於義？謂正尋思如是如是語，有如是如是義。如是名為尋思於義。云何名為尋思於事？謂正尋思內外二事。如是名為尋思於事。云何名為尋思於相？謂正尋思諸法二相。一者、自相，二者、共相。如是名為尋思於相。云何名為尋思於品？謂正尋思諸法二品。一者、黑品，二者、白品。尋思黑品過失過患，尋思白品功德勝利。如是名為尋思於品。云何名為尋思於時？謂正尋思過去、未來、現在三時。尋思如是事，曾在過去世；尋思如是事，當在未來世；尋思如是事，今在現在世。如是名為尋思於時。云何名為尋思於理？謂正尋思四種道理。一、觀待道理，二、作用道理，三、證成道理，四、法爾道理。
items.en: What is investigating meaning? Rightly investigating that such-and-such a word carries such-and-such a meaning. What is investigating substance? Rightly investigating the two substances, inner and outer. What is investigating characteristic? Rightly investigating a phenomenon's two characteristics: its particular characteristic and its universal characteristic. What is investigating category? Rightly investigating a phenomenon's two categories: the dark category and the bright category. What is investigating time? Rightly investigating the three times: past, future, and present. What is investigating principle? Rightly investigating the four principles: the principle of mutual dependence, the principle of function, the principle of valid proof, and the principle of natural law.

items.zh: 當知此中，由觀待道理，尋思世俗以為世俗，尋思勝義以為勝義，尋思因緣以為因緣。由作用道理，尋思諸法所有作用。謂如是如是法，有如是如是作用。由證成道理，尋思三量。一、至教量，二、比度量，三、現證量。謂正尋思如是如是義、為有至教不？為現證可得不？為應比度不？由法爾道理，於如實諸法成立法性、難思法性、安住法性，應生信解，不應思議、不應分別。如是名為尋思於理。如是六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那，及前三門毘鉢舍那，略攝一切毘鉢舍那。問：何因緣故，建立如是六事差別毘鉢舍那？答：依三覺故，如是建立。何等三覺？一、語義覺，二、事邊際覺，三、如實覺。尋思義故，起語義覺；尋思其事及自相故，起事邊際覺；尋思共相、品時、理故，起如實覺。修瑜伽師唯有爾所所知境界。所謂語義，及所知事盡所有性、如所有性。

items.title: Section: The Five Objects for Purifying Conduct — Contemplating Impurity Opens

items.zh: 云何勤修不淨觀者，尋思六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那？謂依不淨增上正法聽聞受持增上力故，由等引地如理作意，解了其義。知此不淨實為不淨，深可厭逆，其性朽穢，惡臭生臭。
items.en: How does one who diligently cultivates the contemplation of impurity investigate insight with objects differentiated by the six things? That is, by the empowering force of having heard and upheld the excellent teaching on impurity, and through sound-reasoning attention within concentrative equipoise, one comes to understand its meaning: knowing that this impurity is truly impurity, deeply loathsome and repugnant, decaying and foul by nature, rank with the stench of both waste and raw flesh.

items.zh: 由如是等種種行相，於先所聞依諸不淨所說正法，解了其義。如是名為於諸不淨尋思其義。

items.title: Investigating Impurity's Substance and Its Particular Characteristics

items.zh: 云何名為尋思彼事？謂彼如是解了義已，觀不淨物，建立二分，謂內及外。如是名為尋思彼事。云何名為尋思自相？謂且於內身中所有穢朽不淨，發起勝解。了知身中有髮、毛等，廣說乃至腦膜、小便。復於如是身中所有多不淨物，攝為二界，發起勝解。所謂地界及以水界。
items.en: What is investigating its substance? That is, having thus understood its meaning, one contemplates the impure substance, establishing it as twofold — inner and outer. What is investigating its particular characteristic? That is, first, with respect to all the decaying impurity within one's own body, one gives rise to a vivid understanding … Further, all the many impure substances within the body are subsumed into two elements, and one gives rise to a vivid understanding of them — namely, the earth element and the water element.

items.zh: 始於髮、毛，乃至大便，起地勝解；始於淚、污乃至小便，起水勝解。如是名為依內不淨尋思自相。

復於其外諸不淨物，由青瘀等種種行相，發起勝解。謂先發起青瘀勝解，或親自見、或從他聞、或由分別所有死屍。如是死屍，或男、或女、或非男女，或親、或怨、或是中庸，或劣、或中、或復是勝，或是少年、或是中年、或是老年。取彼相已，若此死屍死經一日，血流已盡，未至膿爛，於是發起青瘀勝解。若此死屍死經二日，已至膿爛，未生蟲蛆，於是發起膿爛勝解。若此死屍死經七日，已生蟲蛆，身體已壞，於是發起爛壞勝解、𮌨脹勝解。若此死屍為諸狐狼、鵄梟、鵰鷲、烏鵲、餓狗之所食噉，於是發起食噉勝解。即此死屍既被食已，皮肉血盡，唯筋纏骨，於是發起異赤勝解。若此死屍或被食噉，支節分離，散在處處，或有其肉，或無其肉，或餘少肉，於是發起分散勝解。若此死屍骨節分散，手骨異處、足骨異處、膝骨異處、髀骨異處、髖骨異處、髆骨異處、臂骨異處、脊骨異處、頷輪異處、齒鬘異處、髑髏異處，見是事已，起骨勝解。
items.en: Further, with respect to the various impure substances outside the body, one gives rise to a vivid understanding through various forms such as the discoloration of bruising. That is, one first gives rise to the understanding of discoloration … If this corpse has been dead one day, its blood having ceased flowing but not yet reaching decay, one gives rise to the understanding of discoloration. If this corpse has been dead two days, having reached decay … If this corpse has been dead seven days, maggots having already formed and the body having decomposed, one gives rise to the understanding of rot and bloating. If this corpse is devoured by foxes, wolves, owls, vultures, crows and magpies, and starving dogs … flesh and blood entirely gone, only sinew binding bone … the bones' joints scattered apart … the skull lying apart from the rest, seeing this, one gives rise to the understanding of bare bone.

items.zh: 若復思惟如是骸骨共相連接而不分散，唯取麁相，不委細取支節屈曲，如是爾時起鎖勝解。若委細取支節屈曲，爾時發起骨鎖勝勝。又有二鎖。一、形骸鎖，二、支節鎖。形骸鎖者，謂從血鑊脊骨，乃至髑髏所住。支節鎖者，謂臂、髆等骨連鎖，及髀、膞等骨連鎖。此中形骸鎖，說名為鎖；若支節鎖，說名骨鎖。復有二種取骨鎖相。一、取假名綵畫木石泥等所作骨鎖相。二、取真實骨鎖相。若思惟假名骨鎖相時，爾時唯名起鎖勝解，不名骨鎖。若思惟真實骨鎖相時，爾時名起骨鎖勝解。又即此外造色色相，三種變壞。一、自然變壞，二、他所變壞，三、俱品變壞。始從青瘀乃至𮌨脹、是自然變壞。始從食噉乃至分散，是他所變壞。若骨、若鎖、及以骨鎖，是俱品變壞。若能如是如實了知外不淨相，是名尋思外諸所有不淨自相。

blocks.text: The "six things" that insight investigates, and their application to the contemplation of impurity. A long passage (0451c21) and the end of today's reading are untranslated.

Insight investigates **meaning** ("such-and-such a word carries such-and-such a meaning"), **substance** (what the thing actually is, inner or outer), **characteristic** (its own and shared marks), **category** (dark or bright, its faults and merits), **time** (past, future, present), and **principle** (the four principles of reasoning, Day 212).

Through the principle of dependence one examines the conventional as conventional and the ultimate as ultimate; through function, what each thing does; through proof, whether a claim is supported by scripture, inference, and direct perception; through natural law, one accepts "the established nature of things, a nature difficult to conceive", with faith rather than speculation. Why six? Because of three understandings: of the meaning of words (from investigating meaning); of the limit of things (from substance and own-characteristic); and of things as they are (from shared characteristic, category, time, and principle). "This is all a yoga practitioner has to know."
"Knowing that this impurity is truly impurity, deeply loathsome, decaying and foul by nature."

The substance is twofold: inner (the parts of one's own body) and outer (corpses). For the outer, one forms vivid images: "the discoloration of bruising", festering, bloating, and so on. The untranslated passage continues (0452b16): bones; bones linked together loosely seen (a "chain"); or seen in detail with each joint (a "bone chain"); and distinguishes a painted or carved skeleton from a real one.

quiz.q: What are the six things investigated, and what does Venerable Miào Jìng say "inner substance" is?
options: meaning, substance, characteristic, category, time, principle; one's own faculties and aggregates are inner substance
quiz.why: "First, meaning; second, substance; third, characteristic; fourth, category; fifth, time; sixth, principle." Venerable Miào Jìng: your own eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind, and aggregates are "inner substance." He takes "outer" as others' aggregates, while the note says "the external world."

quiz.q: Impurity is "rank with 惡臭 and 生臭." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain 生臭?
options: from flesh and blood decaying — also a transformation of food
quiz.why: "Knowing that this impurity is truly impurity, deeply loathsome and repugnant, decaying and foul by nature, rank with the stench of both waste and raw flesh." Venerable Miào Jìng: 生臭 is "produced by the decay of flesh, blood, and the like" — also a transformation of food.

quiz.q: Who in the desire realm should practise impurity contemplation, according to Master Cháng Bǎi, and why?
options: everyone in the desire realm, since their bodies result from sensual craving
quiz.why: "How does one who diligently cultivates the contemplation of impurity investigate insight with objects differentiated by the six things?" Master Cháng Bǎi: everyone in the desire realm should practise it, because desire-realm beings received this body through sensual craving.

quiz.q: Impure substance is "twofold — inner and outer." How do the masters divide them?
options: Miào Jìng: the living body is inner, the dead one outer; Cháng Bǎi: inner when held by the storehouse consciousness
quiz.why: "One contemplates the impure substance, establishing it as twofold — inner and outer." Venerable Miào Jìng: inner is the body while alive; outer is at death. Master Cháng Bǎi: the body is inner when held by the storehouse consciousness, and one instinctively clings to it as "I" or "mine."

quiz.q: One "gives rise to vivid understanding" of bodily impurity. Does Venerable Miào Jìng count impurity contemplation without absorption as such?
options: one can contemplate without absorption, but it is not vivid understanding
quiz.why: "First, with respect to all the decaying impurity within one's own body, one gives rise to a vivid understanding." Venerable Miào Jìng: without absorption we can still do impurity contemplation in the mind, but that is not "vivid understanding."
